name: str_to_upper
title: Convert string to upper case, lower case, title case, or sentence case

origin.description: Convert each string to upper case.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale for case mapping. Defaults to "en" (English) so the result does not follow the machine locale.

origin.details: The default locale is English, so i becomes I. The Turkish locale tr maps i to İ. German ß expands to SS. A missing string stays missing.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.
origin.example:
dog <- "The quick brown dog"
print(str_to_upper(dog))
print(str_to_upper("i"))
print(str_to_upper("i", "tr"))

translation.description: Convert each string to upper case. The result is a list. A missing string is stringi._na.NA.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: locale

translation.example:
